Moustache in Innsbruck

** Discover the **Moustache** – the cozy, stylish café and restaurant in the heart of **Innsbruck**, where every visit feels like a little escape. Tucked away in the charming **Altstadt**, this hidden gem combines rustic charm with modern flair, offering a perfect blend of relaxation and culinary delights. Indulge in our **Kaiserschmarrn**, fluffy and caramelized, served with fresh fruit compote or a dollop of vanilla cream. For those craving something heartier, our seasonal menu features locally sourced ingredients, from crispy **Tiroler Gröstl** to delicate **Forellen** from the Inn River. Sip on a perfectly brewed coffee or a glass of **Tiroler Apfelstrudel** wine while soaking in the cozy atmosphere. Whether you're here for breakfast, lunch, or an afternoon treat, **Moustache** promises an unforgettable experience in the heart of **Tirol**.
